Authenticate and screen all membership against Seed 627 B512, S615, and protected-holdout snapshots; provenance remains authenticated non-crosswalkable and inherited P-E4 exposure unresolved.

After exact-known-exposure exclusions, satisfy minimum eligible supply of 206/206/204/204/204 for 17/18/19/20/21 active pit stones, respectively.
Select exactly 512 states with stone-bin quotas 103/103/102/102/102 and at least 128 distinct opening clusters.
Enforce maximum four selected states per opening and maximum two per continuation game.
Independent verifier reproduces all generation, screening, candidate supply, deduplication, and selected-population evidence.
Any mandatory gate failure is retained as evidence and stops execution without parameter changes or automatic retry.
Scope excludes inference, MCTS, exact solving, tablebase probes, training, and candidate promotion.
hypothesis: A deterministic model-independent generation and authenticated known-exposure screen can produce an independently reproducible 512-state finite cohort from 256 distinct openings and 2,048 continuation games, satisfying all registered stone-bin supply and cluster constraints.
objective: Generate and independently verify the Seed 623 prospective benchmark population only; preserve known-exposure-screened classification with inherited P-E4 exposure unresolved.
